artists.name: VYSERION
artists.bio: VYSERION operates at the threshold where dark electronic textures collide with alt-pop songcraft. Winner of Best Electronic Act at the 2026 Independent Music Awards for ECLIPSE PROTOCOL — cited as the defining electronic album of the past year — VYSERION has become the label's most decorated act, delivering Wunderland Records its fourth IMA win in three years.

bio: VYSERION is one of the most compelling voices in contemporary dark electronic music — an artist who has built an entire sonic universe from the intersection of industrial textures, alt-pop sensibility, and deeply cinematic production.

Signed to Wunderland Records in 2020, VYSERION quickly established a reputation for live performances that blur the line between concert and ritual — immersive, visceral, and impossible to forget. Their debut album under the label was critically acclaimed across the underground electronic press.

With a growing international fanbase and a string of high-profile sync placements in film and television, VYSERION represents the forward edge of what Wunderland Records stands for: artists who refuse to be categorised.
profile.quote: I don't make music for people to listen to. I make it for people to feel trapped inside.

artists.name: BENTO
artists.bio: BENTO refuses containment. Moving fluidly between urban genres, formats, and cultures, BENTO treats every release as a curated box of sound — each compartment distinct, each serving deliberate. A confirmed joint EP with SKYCHILD, produced entirely by NOVADECK, arrives Summer 2026, alongside a major motion picture sync placement with HIROFORM.

bio: BENTO is a genre-fluid force — an artist who moves between hip-hop, Afrobeats, R&B, and everything in between with an ease that makes categorisation feel redundant. Born from a multicultural background and raised on an eclectic diet of global music, BENTO's sound is a reflection of the world as it actually is.

Signed to Wunderland Records in 2021, BENTO brought an energy to the label that was immediately felt. Their debut project under the imprint debuted in the top 20 of multiple regional charts and earned them a reputation as one of the most exciting live acts in the UK urban scene.
BENTO's approach to music is inseparable from their approach to culture — every release is accompanied by a visual world, a community activation, and a statement of intent.
profile.quote: Every song is a meal. I want people to leave satisfied but already hungry for the next one.

artists.name: NOVADECK
artists.tagline: Architect of sound. Navigator of stars.
artists.bio: NOVADECK is the architect at the center of the Wunderland Records universe — a producer whose cosmic hip-hop instrumentals chart constellations rather than choruses. Following the critical and commercial success of STAR MAPS VOL. 2 and ORBIT, NOVADECK signed a multi-album extension with the label in May 2026, cementing one of the most productive producer-label relationships in the independent sector.

bio: NOVADECK is the producer's producer — a studio architect whose fingerprints can be found across some of the most significant releases in the Wunderland Records catalogue. As a solo artist, NOVADECK operates in the space between cosmic hip-hop, neo-soul, and instrumental composition.

A founding presence in the Wunderland Records creative ecosystem since 2019, NOVADECK has produced records for BENTO, VYSERION, and NOVA while simultaneously building a solo discography that has earned widespread critical respect. Their beat tapes are treated as standalone artistic statements.
NOVADECK's live show — a one-person orchestration of samples, synthesis, and live instrumentation — has been described as 'watching someone compose the universe in real time.'
profile.quote: The best beat is the one that makes the artist feel like they've been waiting for it their whole life.

artists.name: V
artists.bio: V is reduction as philosophy. A single letter, a single beam of light, and compositions stripped to their absolute essence. In December 2025, V's ABSENCE catalogue was acquired by a major international publishing house in an eight-figure deal covering synchronisation, print, and neighbouring rights across 47 territories — proof that silence, precisely arranged, commands a premium.

bio: V is an enigma by design. The artist known only by a single letter operates at the extreme edge of experimental pop — where melody dissolves into texture, where silence is as deliberate as sound, and where the listener is asked to bring as much as the artist gives.

Signed to Wunderland Records in 2022 after a series of anonymous releases that circulated through underground music communities, V's identity and origin remain intentionally obscured. What is known is the music: sparse, precise, and emotionally devastating.

V's debut album under Wunderland Records was released with no press campaign, no interviews, and no social media presence — and still found its way to over two million streams in its first month through word of mouth alone.
profile.quote: I removed everything that wasn't necessary. What's left is everything.

artists.name: SKYCHILD
artists.bio: SKYCHILD makes music for altitudes — indie-electronic compositions suspended in atmosphere, equal parts weightless and grounded. One of the label's most distinct voices, SKYCHILD joins forces with BENTO for a collaborative EP in July 2026, described as 'a conversation between two worlds that shouldn't work together — and absolutely do.'

bio: SKYCHILD is the most emotionally immediate artist on the Wunderland Records roster — an indie-electronic project built around the feeling of being suspended between worlds. Their music exists in the liminal space between dream-pop and ambient electronic, where every song feels like a memory you can't quite place.

Signed in 2021 after a viral moment that saw their self-produced track accumulate millions of streams without any label backing, SKYCHILD brought an organic audience and a fully-formed artistic vision to Wunderland Records. The label's role has been to amplify, not to shape.
SKYCHILD's live shows are known for their immersive visual design — projected cloudscapes, spatial audio, and an intimacy that makes arenas feel like bedrooms.
profile.quote: I write songs for people who feel too much and don't know what to do with it.

artists.name: NOVA
artists.tagline: The brightest thing in the dark.
artists.bio: NOVA's voice is the label's north star — celestial R&B and soul that burns brightest against the black. Her third studio album RADIANT, recorded across London, Lagos, and Los Angeles, arrives August 15, 2026. Described by the artist as 'the most personal and most universal thing I've ever made,' it features production by NOVADECK and collaborations with BENTO and SKYCHILD.

bio: NOVA is the most commercially successful artist on the Wunderland Records roster and one of the most compelling voices in contemporary R&B. Her music — a blend of classic soul architecture, modern production, and a vocal range that defies easy description — has earned her a global audience and a reputation as one of the defining artists of her generation.

Signed to Wunderland Records in 2020, NOVA's debut album under the label debuted at number three on the UK Albums Chart and produced three top-ten singles. Her second album went further, earning her a BRIT Award nomination and a headline slot at a major European festival.

Beyond the music, NOVA is a cultural figure — a voice on issues of identity, representation, and the politics of being a Black woman in the music industry. Her platform is as important as her catalogue.
profile.quote: I was told I was too much. I decided that was the whole point.

artists.name: HIROFORM
artists.bio: HIROFORM builds sound the way architects build structures — industrial-ambient frameworks engineered down to the hertz. Commissioned in January 2026 to compose the original score for an upcoming Netflix limited series, a psychological thriller due Q3 2026, HIROFORM's sound architecture is now reaching its largest audience yet.

bio: HIROFORM is the most technically uncompromising artist in the Wunderland Records family — a producer and performer whose work sits at the intersection of industrial architecture, future-bass energy, and ambient precision. Their music is built, not written: engineered from the ground up with the same rigour as structural design.

Signed in 2022 after a series of releases on independent electronic labels that earned them a devoted following in the club and festival circuit, HIROFORM brought a different energy to Wunderland Records — colder, more precise, and more demanding of the listener.

HIROFORM's live performances are technical spectacles — custom-built hardware, reactive visuals, and a sound system specification that most venues struggle to meet. They are, by design, an acquired taste that becomes an obsession.
profile.quote: Every sound has a shape. I just make the shapes visible.

artists.name: CEROMINUSONE
artists.bio: CEROMINUSONE works in negative space — experimental noise and industrial abstraction that subtracts until only the essential violence of sound remains. The project's releases are less albums than controlled demolitions, each one dismantling the idea of what a record is supposed to be.

bio: CEROMINUSONE is Wunderland Records' most uncompromising sonic experiment — a project built entirely on the principle of subtraction. Where other artists add layers, CEROMINUSONE removes them, leaving behind only the essential frequency, the irreducible signal, the sound that cannot be cut without silence.

Operating at the intersection of noise art, industrial composition, and dark ambient, CEROMINUSONE challenges the listener's definition of music itself. Their releases are not albums in the traditional sense — they are documents of a process, evidence of a system being dismantled and rebuilt in real time.

Signed to Wunderland Records in 2023 after a series of limited-run physical releases that circulated exclusively through underground art spaces and noise collectives, CEROMINUSONE represents the label's commitment to art that refuses to be categorised.
profile.quote: The most honest sound is the one that remains when you've removed everything you were told to keep.

artists.name: SPEAKEASY
artists.bio: SPEAKEASY lives where the lights are low and the truths are loud — jazz-trap arrangements beneath spoken word confessionals and soul hooks. Where jazz once met the trap, SPEAKEASY built a room, poured a drink, and started talking. Every track is an after-hours session you weren't supposed to hear.

bio: SPEAKEASY is the sound of a secret being told in a crowded room. A jazz-trap poet and vocalist whose music lives in the space between the underground bar and the arena — intimate enough to whisper, powerful enough to fill a cathedral.

Drawing from the golden age of jazz lyricism, the rhythmic architecture of trap, and the confessional tradition of spoken word, SPEAKEASY creates music that feels simultaneously timeless and urgently contemporary. Every track is a story; every story is a warning.

Discovered through a viral late-night session recording that circulated through music circles in 2022, SPEAKEASY was signed to Wunderland Records in 2023. Their debut album 'PROHIBITION' was described as one of the most distinctive debut records of the decade.
profile.quote: Every song I write is a door I wasn't supposed to open. I open them anyway.

artists.name: WUNDERLAND
artists.bio: WUNDERLAND is the label's namesake and its strangest dream — ethereal dream-pop that invites listeners into a mad world of alternative textures and hallucinated melodies. The project embodies the label's founding thesis: that wonder, fully committed to, becomes a genre of its own.

bio: WUNDERLAND — the artist, not the corporation — is the label's most surreal and otherworldly voice. A dream-pop visionary whose music exists in the space between waking and sleep, between memory and imagination, between the world as it is and the world as it could be.

Named in homage to the corporation that gave them a home, WUNDERLAND the artist embodies the label's founding philosophy: that art should disorient before it comforts, that beauty is most powerful when it is strange. Their music is a labyrinth — you enter willingly, and you are never quite sure of the way out.

Signed in 2024 following a series of self-released concept albums that built a devoted cult following, WUNDERLAND brings a theatrical, immersive quality to the label's roster that no other artist can replicate.
profile.quote: Reality is just a story someone told you. I'm here to tell you a better one.

artists.name: JULIAN.EXE
artists.bio: JULIAN.EXE is a program that refuses to terminate — cyberpunk digital trap executing in endless loops of creation and destruction. Each release runs like a process: initialize, corrupt, crash, reboot. The glitch is not the flaw. The glitch is the feature.

bio: JULIAN.EXE is a digital identity — a producer and artist who treats music as code, the studio as a terminal, and the listener as the system being executed. Their music is fast, precise, and deliberately disorienting: trap rhythms filtered through cyberpunk aesthetics, melodies that feel like corrupted data reassembling itself in real time.

The name is both a statement and a threat. JULIAN.EXE is not a person — it is a process. A program running on the hardware of contemporary culture, exploiting vulnerabilities in genre convention, overwriting the expected with the unexpected.

Signed to Wunderland Records in 2024 after a series of releases that circulated through underground tech communities and digital art spaces, JULIAN.EXE represents the label's expanding vision of what electronic music can be in the age of artificial intelligence and digital identity.
profile.quote: I don't make music. I write programs that happen to sound like music.

artists.name: MSBOZZYB
artists.bio: The newest signing to the Wunderland Records roster, MSBOZZYB delivers R&B and trap-soul draped in silk — luxury in every note, opulence in every arrangement. Her debut project is currently in development, and the label expects nothing less than a defining statement of modern trap-soul.

bio: MSBOZZYB is the most commercially powerful and artistically uncompromising voice in the Wunderland Records roster. An R&B and trap-soul artist whose music combines the emotional depth of neo-soul with the sonic ambition of contemporary pop, MSBOZZYB writes songs that feel like confessions dressed in couture.

Her music is defined by a rare combination of vulnerability and authority — she writes about love, power, identity, and ambition with equal conviction, and her vocal delivery carries the weight of every word. MSBOZZYB does not perform emotion; she transmits it.

Signed to Wunderland Records in 2024, MSBOZZYB has already established herself as one of the label's most important signings. Her debut album 'EMERALD' debuted at number one across multiple markets and earned her three award nominations in her first year.
profile.quote: I built this from nothing. Now I build it into everything.

news.title: NOVADECK Signs Multi-Album Extension with Wunderland Records
news.body: Following the critical and commercial success of STAR MAPS VOL. 2 and ORBIT, NOVADECK has extended their partnership with Wunderland Records for a further three albums, cementing one of the most productive producer-label relationships in the independent sector.

news.title: NOVA Announces Third Studio Album — 'RADIANT' — Due August 2026
news.body: Wunderland Records is proud to announce that NOVA's highly anticipated third studio album, RADIANT, will arrive on August 15, 2026. The album was recorded across London, Lagos, and Los Angeles and is described by NOVA as 'the most personal and most universal thing I've ever made.'

news.title: VYSERION Wins Best Electronic Act at the Independent Music Awards
news.body: VYSERION took home the Best Electronic Act award at the 2026 Independent Music Awards ceremony in New York, citing ECLIPSE PROTOCOL as the defining electronic album of the past year. The win marks Wunderland Records' fourth IMA win in three years.

news.title: SKYCHILD & BENTO Confirm Joint EP for Summer 2026
news.body: Two of Wunderland Records' most distinct voices are joining forces. SKYCHILD and BENTO have confirmed a collaborative EP set for release in July 2026, produced entirely by NOVADECK. The project is described as 'a conversation between two worlds that shouldn't work together — and absolutely do.'

news.title: HIROFORM Scores Original Soundtrack for Netflix Limited Series
news.body: HIROFORM has been commissioned to compose the original score for an upcoming Netflix limited series, marking the artist's most high-profile sync placement to date. The series, set for a Q3 2026 release, is described as a psychological thriller — a natural fit for HIROFORM's industrial-ambient sound architecture.

news.title: V's 'ABSENCE' Catalogue Acquired by Major Publishing House in Eight-Figure Deal
news.body: Wunderland Records' publishing arm has completed the licensing of V's ABSENCE catalogue to a major international publishing house in a deal reported to be in the eight-figure range. The agreement covers synchronisation, print, and neighbouring rights across 47 territories.
